coach.not_allowed: Coach is for the people KIFF lets use it, by default the account's admins.
coach.not_connectable: Connecting tools isn't set up for this account from this phone. Open Coach to start it.
coach.not_connected: The sign-in at {vendor} didn't connect: the connection is {status}. Nothing was connected. Try signing in again.
coach.not_set_up_here: Connecting tools isn't set up for this account from this phone. Start from tafs on an iPhone.
coach.nothing_to_approve: {vendor} is already connected. There's nothing new to approve, so nothing was approved.
coach.reading_kiff_words: Reading KIFF's words for this connection…
coach.sign_in_note: The vendor's own page opens. Your password and keys are never shown here, and your sign-in is kept sealed.
coach.taken.named: Coach can't have its tools yet: another tool in KIFF is named {name}. Rename or remove it in KIFF.
coach.taken.unnamed: Coach can't have its tools yet: another tool in KIFF is named as one of them. Rename or remove it in KIFF.
coach.tools_unknown: KIFF didn't answer about Coach's tools. Try again in a moment.
coach.waiting_for_vendor: If the vendor's sign-in page opened, finish it there and come back.

connect.disconnect.also_cards: The Cards of {names} also use these tools, so they stop too.
connect.disconnect.no_taf_uses: No taf uses this {vendor} connection now. Its tools leave KIFF.
connect.disconnect.rest: Other connections to {vendor} stay connected. If no other connection uses this sign-in, it's revoked at {vendor}. Connecting again asks you to approve and sign in again.
connect.disconnect.title: Disconnect {vendor}?

connect.kept.for_card.other: Kept {count} for {who}, whose Card uses them.

connect.kept.for_cards.other: Kept {count} for {who}, whose Cards use them.

door.add_intro: Give {taf} an address people can write to. It has none until you turn one on, and its Card still decides what it does.

door.day.open.one: {today} of {count} from you and paired senders today. Text only: attachments aren't opened, and the reply says so.
door.day.open.other: {today} of {count} from you and paired senders today. Text only: attachments aren't opened, and the reply says so.

door.day.resting.one: {count} of {count} from you and paired senders today. More are dropped until tomorrow.
door.day.resting.other: {count} of {count} from you and paired senders today. More are dropped until tomorrow.

door.do_it.default: Do what it asks, within your Card.

door.do_it.intro_it: {who}'s message goes with your words, as information. It acts on what you say, within its Card, and doesn't write back to them unless you ask.
door.do_it.title: Tell {taf} what to do
door.do_it.title_your_taf: Tell your taf what to do

door.key.none: {how}, so no one here can give {taf} work. Everything that comes through knocks.

door.knock.proof_failed: It says it's from {from}, but it didn't pass the sender check, so it's treated as a stranger's.
door.knock.proof_none: This door can't prove who wrote it.

door.knock.rest_keys.other: This door had its messages from you and paired senders for today. {count} more were dropped.

door.knock.rest_others.other: This door had its messages from people who aren't paired for today. {count} more were dropped.

door.no_door_yet: {taf} has no door yet. Someone who manages it can add one.

door.remove_body: Its address stops being {taf}'s. Messages already in its chat stay.

door.slack.no_account: This Slack connection isn't ready yet. Try again in a moment.

door.slack.which_bot: Which Slack connection is it for?
door.slack.which_channel: Which channel does it answer in? New messages there will start work.

error.busy: Too many tries just now. Try again in a minute.
error.changed: It changed in the meantime. What's shown now is how it is.
error.down: It isn't working on our side right now. Nothing to do on your side; try again later.
error.not_allowed: Your role on this account doesn't allow this.
error.offline: It didn't reach the server. Try again once you're online.
error.ours: This phone and the server didn't understand each other. Nothing to do on your side; we're on it.
error.signed_out: You're signed out. Sign in again.
export.not_offered: The files couldn't be saved on this phone. Free up some space, then try again.
halt.explain.halted: Halted. Nothing reaches your tools. When you resume, only new work runs: nothing from before the halt picks up again.
halt.explain.halted_since: Halted since {time}. Nothing reaches your tools. When you resume, only new work runs: nothing from before the halt picks up again.
halt.explain.halting: Nothing new starts. Halted shows once KIFF and the connection both confirm.
halt.explain.running_all: Halting stops your tafs: no run starts, and nothing reaches your tools until you resume. A call already on its way may still arrive; nothing is undone.
halt.explain.running_one: Halting stops it: no run starts, and nothing reaches your tools until you resume. A call already on its way may still arrive; nothing is undone.

version.card_note.issues: While it switches, your taf doesn't run. Confirming once issues these Cards in KIFF, then this version goes live.
version.card_note.removes: While it switches, your taf doesn't run. Confirming once issues these Cards in KIFF and removes the ones this version doesn't have, then this version goes live.
version.first_only: One version so far. When you improve it, each change is kept here.
version.guide.give_task: Give it a task that uses the change, as you would the live {name}.
version.guide.install_or_back: Install makes it the live version; Go back ends the trial.
version.guide.keeps_working: {name} keeps working as it is. What this version does is real, under its own Card.
version.guide.trial_ends: The trial ends {date} if you don't use it.
version.intro: Installing a version makes it the live version, forward or back. One confirmation covers it.
version.not_a_trial.confirmed: KIFF didn't start a trial: it issued these Cards as the taf's own. Check its Card tab, or install the version you had.
version.not_a_trial.other: KIFF didn't start a trial for this version (it answered {status}). Nothing runs under it.
version.out_of_date_card: What you're asked to approve changed since it was shown. Read it again, then approve.
version.try_first: Try a version first: you chat with it under a Card of its own, while the live version keeps working.
version.while_you_try.chat: You chat with version {n} in its own window. What it does is real: its calls go through KIFF under the Card below.
version.while_you_try.counts_from_zero: The trial's Card counts from zero, so on a day your taf can spend its live Card's limits plus this one's.
version.while_you_try.ends: It ends when you install it or go back, or after 7 days unused. Its chat is then deleted, and Versions keeps one line about it.
version.while_you_try.live_keeps_working: The live version keeps working: its schedule, Card and budget don't change.
